source.quoted_text: Sch Art. 34 (both columns): '(a) When possession of the property or any part of the property comprised in such deed is given by the mortgagor or agreed to be given — The same duty as conveyance (No. 20) for a market value equal to the amount secured by such deed.' Explanation: a mortgagor giving the mortgagee a POA to collect rents or a lease of the mortgaged property is deemed to give possession.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (official DPAL). Same duty as Conveyance Art 20(1) = 5% of the amount secured. Mortgage is NOT in the s.3B cess list (conveyance/exchange/settlement/gift/lease-in-perpetuity only), so NO 10% infra cess — correct. Deemed-possession (POA to collect rents / lease) is a classification question.

source.ref: Karnataka Stamp Act, 1957, Sch. Art. 34(b) (subst. by Act 8 of 2003)
source.quoted_text: Sch Art. 34(b) (both columns): 'When possession is not given or agreed to be given as aforesaid and not being a hypothecation — Fifty paise for every hundred rupees or part thereof for the amount secured by such deed.' = 0.5% of the amount secured, no cap.

source.quoted_text: Sch Art. 34(d) (both columns): 'for hypothecation of movable property — If the loan or debt is repayable on demand — (i) where the loan amount does not exceed rupees ten lakhs — rupees ten for every rupees ten thousands or part thereof [= 0.1%]; (ii) where the loan amount exceeds rupees ten lakhs — rupees twenty for every rupees ten thousands or part thereof [= 0.2%], subject to a maximum of rupees ten lakhs.'
